displayName: 序列编号N Serial Designation N
description: Unofficial fan art of Serial Designation N from Murder Drones. A friendly companion with cap-straightening salutes, paper-airplane folding and recovery, a soft dog-plush interaction, and long-stride mechanical running in three directions. The single tail uses a sealed rounded yellow capsule as an explicit safe replacement for the hazardous needle; hands are ordinary and wings remain concealed. No weapons or combat; no affiliation or endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
